title: Private Architectural Walk Through Montréal’s Underground City
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a fascinating, private journey through Montreal’s hidden underground city, a sprawling network beneath the vibrant streets of downtown. As you navigate this subterranean labyrinth, you’ll uncover exclusive shops and exquisite dining options shielded from the weather above. Surface in the bustling heart of Downtown Montreal to soak in the rich history and modern pulse of the city. Your adventure culminates at Place des Arts, where the best of Montreal’s cultural scene comes to life. This tour isn’t just a visit; it’s a discovery of hidden gems and celebrated landmarks making you the hero of your Montreal story.

Please note: The program and attractions may vary based on booking date/time and crowd conditions, ensuring each visit is a unique experience.
